    rq = canada_roster_quality_probability
    nhl = nhl_participation_probability
    comp_fav = competition_strength_favorability_probability
    health = health_availability_probability
    var_fav = tournament_variance_favorability_probability
    reach = reach_final_probability
    win = win_final_given_final_probability

    base_lo = log(odds(base))

    p1_team = rq * nhl
    p2_rival_not_overwhelming = comp_fav
    p3_avail = nhl * health
    p4_low_upset = var_fav

    lo_team = log(odds(p1_team))
    lo_rival = log(odds(p2_rival_not_overwhelming))
    lo_avail = log(odds(p3_avail))
    lo_var = log(odds(p4_low_upset))

    w_team = abs(lo_team) + ONE
    w_rival = abs(lo_rival) + ONE
    w_avail = abs(lo_avail) + ONE
    w_var = abs(lo_var) + ONE

    s_team = lo_team / w_team
    s_rival = lo_rival / w_rival
    s_avail = lo_avail / w_avail
    s_var = lo_var / w_var

    stage = base_lo
    stage = stage + s_team
    stage = stage + s_avail
    stage = stage + s_rival
    stage = stage + s_var

    base_out = logistic(stage)

    path = reach * win
    path_gap = path - HALF

    path_weight = abs(path_gap) + ONE
    path_adj = path_gap / path_weight

    final = base_out + path_adj
    final = clamp(final, ZERO, ONE)
    return final

    rivals_fav = competition_strength_favorability_probability
    health = health_availability_probability
    var_fav = tournament_variance_favorability_probability

    reach = reach_final_probability
    win_final = win_final_given_final_probability

    # Convert each checkable proposition into a log-odds adjustment around 0.5.
    l_base = log(odds(base))

    l_team = log(odds(roster)) + log(odds(nhl))
    l_avail = log(odds(health))
    l_rivals = log(odds(rivals_fav))
    l_var = log(odds(var_fav))

    # "Path" framing: sometimes reason directly as reach-final * win-final,
    # then convert that into an odds term.
    path = reach * win_final
    l_path = log(odds(path))

    # Combine: base anchored, then add/subtract proposition terms.
    # Rival strength and variance reduce chances, so subtract their log-odds.
    l_total = l_base
    l_total += l_team
    l_total += l_avail
    l_total -= l_rivals
    l_total -= l_var

    # Blend with path-based view by averaging in log-odds space.
    l_total = (l_total + l_path) * HALF

    out = logistic(l_total)
    out = clamp(out, ZERO, ONE)
    return out

def forecast():
    nhl = p_nhl_participation
    elite = p_usa_elite_roster_or_top_contender
    healthy = p_no_major_disruption_or_good_health
    reach = p_usa_reach_final
    win_given = p_usa_win_final_given_reach
    canada_fav = p_stronger_opponent_or_canada_favorite
    var = tournament_variance_probability

    # Preconditions for "normal NHL-era tournament with USA as a true contender"
    p_normal = nhl * elite * healthy

    # Core tournament path estimate (what the excerpt describes as the conditional win model)
    p_path = reach * win_given

    # When conditions are less than ideal, the forecaster "marks down" the path estimate.
    # The markdown is driven mainly by roster quality (elite), then health/system shocks,
    # and is softened by tournament variance (more variance => less predictable favorites).
    softness = (ONE - var) * canada_fav
    condition_mix = (elite + healthy) / TWO
    markdown = ONE - softness * (ONE - condition_mix)

    # Synthesis: under normal conditions use the path estimate; otherwise apply markdown.
    p_gold = p_path * (p_normal + (ONE - p_normal) * markdown)

    return p_gold
